基本前向-后向分裂诱导网络的深层极限与稳定性分析（二）：学习问题Deep-layer limit and stability analysis of the basic forward-backward-splitting induced network (II): learning problems

Xuan Lin    Chunlin Wu*
（日期）(Date)
摘要Abstract

在过去的十年中，源自迭代优化方案和数值常微分方程/偏微分方程（ODE/PDE）的深度展开神经网络引起了数据科学领域的广泛关注。 其中，许多重要的网络架构都是根据基本的前向-后向分裂（FBS）算法构建的。 在本文中，我们继续研究最基本的 FBS 诱导网络，这是一种通过结合直接参数松弛从原始 FBS 算法展开的架构。 遵循我们之前的正向系统分析中的差异/差异包含公式，我们在这里考虑相应学习问题的一些理论方面。 在一些温和的假设下，我们建立了基本 FBS 诱导网络的训练问题到深层极限系统的学习问题的一般收敛性质，这意味着Deep unfolding neural networks derived from iterative optimization schemes and numerical ordinary/partial differential equations (ODEs/PDEs) have attracted much attention in data science over the last decade. Therein, numerous important network architectures were constructed from the basic forward-backward-splitting (FBS) algorithm. In this paper, we continue our research on the most basic FBS-induced network, an architecture unrolled from the original FBS algorithm by incorporating direct parameter relaxations. Following the difference/differential inclusion formulations in our previous forward system analyses, we here consider some theoretical aspects of corresponding learning problems. Under some mild assumptions, we establish a general convergence property of the training problem of the basic FBS-induced network to the learning problem of the deep-layer limit system, implying aΓ\Gamma-收敛性论证表明网络最优学习参数的任何聚类点都是深层极限系统学习问题的解。 还对这些学习问题的扰动稳定性进行了定性分析。 进行了一个简单的数值实验来验证我们的主要通用收敛结果。-convergence argument showing that any cluster point of the optimal learning parameters for the network is a solution to the learning problem of the deep-layer limit system. A qualitative analysis of perturbation stabilities of these learning problems is also presented. A simple numerical experiment is conducted to validate our main general convergence result.

关键词：keywords:
前后分割、深度展开/展开、动态包含、Forward-backward splitting, Deep unfolding/unrolling, Dynamical inclusion,Γ\Gamma-收敛性、稳定性。-convergence, Stability.

1 简介Introduction

在本文中，我们继续之前的研究In this paper, we continue our previous study in[1]关于所谓基本 FBS 网络的深层极限分析。 这里的“基本”是指神经网络 网络是通过直接参数松弛从原始 FBS 算法展开的。 使用我们之前的前向系统动态包含模型on deep-layer limit analysis of the so-called basic FBS-network. Here, "basic" means that the neural network is unrolled from the original FBS algorithm with direct parameter relaxation. Using our previous dynamical inclusion modeling of forward systems in[1]，我们在这里考虑学习问题的深层限制和相关的稳定性方面。, we here consider the deep-layer limit of the learning problem and related stability aspects.

事实上，近年来，人们对数据科学中深度神经网络 (DNN) 的深层极限建模和分析越来越感兴趣，这有助于解释 DNN 中的行为和机制。 特别是，著名的 ResNet 可以被描述为 ODEIndeed, there has been growing interest in deep-layer limit modeling and analysis for deep neural networks (DNNs) in data science in recent years, which helps to interpret the behaviors and mechanisms in DNNs. In particular, the well-known ResNets can be characterized as an ODE[2, 3, 4]或普通微分包含 (ODI)or an ordinary differential inclusion (ODI)[5]在深层极限。 最近，没有层归一化的 Transformer 架构及其变体已被解释为（耦合）ODE 系统in the deep-layer limit. Recently, Transformer architecture without layer normalization and its variants have been interpreted as a (coupled) ODE systems[6, 7]。 此外，具有一般非局部框架的密集连接网络（DenseNet）已被数学建模为深层极限下的非线性积分方程. Moreover, densely connected network (DenseNet) with a general nonlocal framework has been mathematically modeled as a nonlinear integral equation in the deep-layer limit[8]。 对于由数值 ODE 导出的网络. For networks induced from numerical ODEs[9, 10]或随时间变化的偏微分方程or time-dependent PDEs[11, 12]，例如可训练的反应扩散, such as trainable reaction diffusion[13]，PDE-Net 及其变体, PDE-Net and its variant[14, 15]，稳定/可逆网络, stable/reversible networks[16, 4, 17, 18], LM-ResNet [19], 神经常微分方程, neural ODE[20]，具有多重网格结构的网络, networks with multigrid structures[21, 22]，以及更多从连续的角度来看, and more from a continuous viewpoint[23]，它们的深层限制自然是它们起源的系统。 这些研究有助于表明网络架构的稳定性等一些特性, their deep-layer limits are naturally the systems from which they originated. These studies help to indicate some properties such as stabilities of network architectures[16, 4, 24, 19, 17, 5, 18]，或者设计一些新颖有趣的架构, or design some novel and interesting architectures[16, 19, 4, 21, 5, 23, 22].

然而，对于那些网络However, for those networks[25, 26, 27, 28, 29, 30]从迭代优化算法中展开unrolled from iterative optimization algorithms[31, 32, 33]在成像相关反问题中发挥着重要作用，但目前对深层极限分析的研究还很少which play important roles in imaging-related inverse problems, there is so far little study on deep-layer limit analysis[1, 34]。 其中，. Therein,[34]研究了基于 ODE 学习原对偶方法的动力系统建模，同时studied a dynamical system modeling based on ODE for learned primal-dual method, while[1]提出了最基本的 FBS 网络的动态包含模型。 由于FBS算法及其变体催生了像LISTA这样的几个相关的重要网络proposed a dynamical inclusion modeling for the most basic FBS-network. As the FBS algorithm and its variants have induced several related significant networks like LISTA[25], 阿利斯塔, ALISTA[26], ISTA-网, ISTA-Net[35], FISTA-网, FISTA-Net[36], 变分网络, variational networks[29]、PFBS-IR 和 PFBS-AIR, PFBS-IR and PFBS-AIR[37]，我们现在重点关注这个算法，继续之前对中最基本的诱导网络结构的研究, we now focus on this algorithm and continue our previous study on the most basic induced network structure in[1]。 本文的主要贡献可概括如下. The main contributions of this paper can be summarized as follows

  • ∙\bullet

    我们展示了在一定条件下基本 FBS 网络及其深层极限系统的学习问题的解的存在性。We show the existence of solutions to the learning problems of the basic FBS-network and its deep-layer limit system, under certain conditions.

  • ∙\bullet

    我们建立了基本 FBS 网络的学习问题与其深层极限系统的学习问题的通用收敛结果，表明We establish a general convergence result from the learning problem of the basic FBS-network to that of its deep-layer limit system, indicatingΓ\Gamma-趋同和相关后果。-convergence and related consequences.

  • ∙\bullet

    我们从初始状态、观测数据和标签方面提出了基本 FBS 网络及其深层极限系统的学习问题的扰动稳定性。We present perturbation stabilities of the learning problems for the basic FBS-network and its deep-layer limit system, in terms of the initial state, the observed data, and the label.

这些结果证明了基本 FBS 网络的学习问题与其深层极限系统之间的深度一致性及其稳定性。 我们的分析方法允许一种简化的变体，能够分析从 FBS 类型的算法展开的其他网络的深层限制，例如 LISTA 和 ALISTA。These results demonstrate a deep consistency between the learning problems of the basic FBS-network and its deep-layer limit system, as well as their stabilities. Our analysis method admits a simplified variant capable of analyzing the deep-layer limit of other networks unrolled from the FBS type of algorithms, such as LISTA and ALISTA.

2.2 其他一些案例，如 LISTASome other cases like LISTA

上述基于包含的问题（The above inclusion-based problems (2.4) 和 () and (2.5）可以适用于由 FBS 算法导出的一些其他情况。 由于 LISTA 是该主题中最早的一个，因此我们这里以它为例。 回忆起) can be adapted to some other cases induced from the FBS algorithm. 备注3.8Remark 3.8.

该定理给出了在相对更一般的领域内从离散时间到连续时间设置的学习问题的目标函数的一般收敛性。 然而，我们不能借用优化中的常用技术来直接从这个结果中导出最小化器的收敛性，因为目标函数的形式随着时间的推移而不断变化。This theorem gives a general convergence of objective functional of the learning problems from the discrete- to continuous-time setting, over a relatively more general domain. However, we cannot borrow the usual techniques in optimization to derive the convergence of the minimizers directly from this result, because the form of objective functional keeps changing alongNN，并且每个泛函通常都不是强凸的。, and each of the functional is in general not strongly convex.

Second, the marginal improvement gradually diminishes as the network becomes deeper, indicating that the network performance gradually tends to a limit. 6 结论Conclusion

在过去的十年中，FBS 算法已经被展开，在稀疏编码和图像恢复方面构建了多个有效的神经网络。 在本文中，我们研究了具有直接参数松弛的基本 FBS 网络的学习问题的深层限制和稳定性行为，如In the last decade, the FBS algorithm has been unrolled to build several effective neural networks in sparse coding and image restoration. In this paper, we studied the deep-layer limit and stability behaviors of the learning problems of the basic FBS-network with direct parameter relaxations as given in[1]。 在动态包含正向建模下，我们建立了网络训练问题与相关深层极限学习问题的一些收敛性质，并给出了上述两个学习问题的稳定性结果。 我们的分析过程可以简化，以便从 FBS 类型算法（例如 LISTA 和 ALISTA 网络）的其他展开网络得出类似的结果。 这些理论结果在某种意义上表明，这种 FBS 诱导的学习方法可以在不同层数下稳定且一致地工作。. Under the dynamical inclusion forward modeling, we established some convergence properties of the network training problem to the related deep-layer limit learning problem, and presented stability results of the above two learning problems. Our analysis procedure can be simplified to derive similar results for other unrolling networks from FBS-type algorithms, such as LISTA and ALISTA networks. These theoretical results indicate, in some sense, that such FBS-induced learning methods can work stably and consistently with different numbers of layers.
